body.purpose: Table cells, form text, descriptions. Set in SN Pro.

label.purpose: Tabs, badges, small buttons, table headers; bold only for the active nav item.

mono.purpose: Chakra default mono stack; rarely used.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single primary action of a view (e.g. Iniciar sesión, Exportar CSV).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary (e.g. Exportar PDF).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: #000; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Outline Button
components.description: Logout and other destructive or exit actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #dc2626; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #fca5a5; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fef2f2; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dc2626; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Audience Badge
components.description: Marks which price list the visitor sees.
components.css: .ds-badge-audience { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #eef2ff; color: #3730a3; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.33 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Restriction Tag
components.description: Allergen/restriction tag under a product name.
components.css: .ds-badge-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #f4f4f5; color: #52525b; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.33 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Portal Tab Bar
components.description: Underline tabs; active = bold + indigo underline + aria-current.
components.html: InicioMis pedidosCarritoCuenta
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid #f4f4f5; font-family: 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #52525b; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #000; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] { color: #4f46e5; font-weight: 700; border-bottom-color: #6366f1; }

components.name: Price Table
components.description: Striped outline table; prices right-aligned, es-AR format.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.43 'SN Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #000; } .ds-table th { text-align: left; font-weight: 500; color: #52525b; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e4e7; } .ds-table td { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e4e7; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) { background: #fafafa; } .ds-table .ds-num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Toscana Pastry is the shop's ledger: prices, stock, orders, and budgets kept in one honest book. The interface exists to make numbers trustworthy and easy to scan. Tables, clear labels, and plain-sans text carry the work. Ornament stays out of the way of the figures.

Today the system is provisional. It is Chakra UI v3's default theme with one custom color scale (`brand`, an unmodified copy of Tailwind's indigo). There is no logo and no product imagery. The typeface is SN Pro. Light and dark modes: white panels on a #fafafa canvas in light, stepped near-black surfaces in dark. Mode follows the OS until the user toggles it in the navbar (next-themes, `dark` class on `<html>`). The admin side is a desktop work surface; the customer portal is a mobile path entered from a WhatsApp link.

The confirmed intent for components is **warm and approachable**: friendlier corners and more breathing room than the current defaults, especially on customer-facing screens. The current code does not yet deliver that; new work should move toward it without breaking the ledger's clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Chakra UI v3 defaults; single accent (indigo `brand`), zinc neutrals.
Light mode only; white background, thin gray rules.
Tables are the primary data surface (catalog, orders, ingredients).
Active state never relies on color alone (bold weight + underline), per WCAG 2.1 AA.
Toasts via `goey-toast`, Spanish (es-AR) copy, es-AR number formatting.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo `brand` is the only accent. Status colors (red, green, orange) mean state, never decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Use semantic tokens (`bg`, `bg.panel`, `fg`, `fg.muted`, `border`, `<palette>.fg`, `<palette>.solid`) and never raw shades (`gray.200`, `brand.600`, hex). Raw shades do not switch with the mode.

rules.name: The Role-Not-Default Rule
rules.body: Every `<Button>` declares its role: `colorPalette="brand"` (primary), `variant="outline"` (secondary), `variant="ghost"` (tertiary/nav) or `colorPalette="red"` (destructive). A bare `<Button>` falls back to Chakra's gray solid, which renders white in dark mode.

rules.name: The Weight-Means-State Rule
rules.body: Bold in navigation marks the current page. Don't use bold for decoration in nav.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat on the page. Separate regions with a rule or spacing, not a shadow.

dos: Do use `colorPalette="brand"` for the single primary action of a view, and outline for its secondary.
Do use Chakra semantic tokens (`bg`, `fg.muted`, `border.muted`) for neutrals.
Do color status text with `red.fg`, `green.fg`, `orange.fg` (700 in light, 300 in dark). Chakra's `fg.error` / `fg.success` / `fg.warning` are 500/600 in light mode and fail 4.5:1 on white.
Do use `variant="subtle"` for green status badges and tags; white on `green.solid` (green.600) is 3.29:1.
Do mark the active nav item with weight + underline + `aria-current`, never color alone.
Do keep portal touch targets at least 44px tall.
Do right-align prices and format them `toLocaleString("es-AR", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })`.
Do put theme changes in `frontend/src/components/ui/theme.ts`, not inline hex values.
donts: Don't add a second accent color or decorative gradients; the One Accent Rule holds until a redesign.
Don't separate surfaces with shadows; use 1px rules.
Don't invent a logo, mascot, or product photos; none exist (see PRODUCT.md).
Don't set `fontFamily` inline; type comes from Chakra's `fonts.body` / `fonts.heading` tokens (SN Pro).
